name: Clock in + claims check
description: Logs in as the ArgusBot smoke account, clocks in, reads the approval status, then walks the new-claim form to the end and cancels.
steps: Wait 90 s and read the approval status
Open Claims and walk the new-claim form to the end, then Cancel (nothing submitted)

name: Clock out
description: Logs in, clocks out and reads the approval status.
steps: Wait 90 s and read the approval status

name: Artemis nginx
description: Is AltomateHR's web server up? No login and no browser.
steps: Public site https://hr.altomate.io/ loads (200 from nginx)
The app behind nginx answers its heartbeat (normally 405)
nginx answers directly on artemis over the private network
artemis's SSH port answers (connect only, never logs in)
HTTPS certificate has at least 14 days left

name: Claims check
description: The read-only claims walk on its own. It also runs inside the 09:00 check.
steps: Walk the new-claim form to the end
Confirm “Submit claim” is there, then Cancel
